what_it_states: Setting: smooth conjugation-invariant hermitian line bundles L_j, A, B on an arithmetic variety, with B of degree 0, and a section s of A. Then the integral over X(C) of log‖s‖_A against the forms of B and the L_j equals a sum minus a correction. The sum runs over horizontal components W of div(s), each weighted by its multiplicity times ∫_{W(C)} log h_B ∧ ∏c₁(L_j). The correction is ∫_{X(C)} log h_A against the same forms. This is an integration-by-parts identity from the Poincaré-Lelong formula.

what_it_states: Consider Siegel Eisenstein series on the doubled unitary group U(Y⊕−Y), for standard sections attached to a Hecke character. They converge and are holomorphic for Re s > t. what_it_states: Setting: a definite (min(r,s) = 0, hence anisotropic) hermitian or skew-hermitian space A of rank m, a space Y of rank n, and doubling data. The Siegel Eisenstein series of the Siegel-Weil section is holomorphic at s₀ = (m−n)/2. Its value there is κ times the average of the theta function over U(A), with κ = 1 if n < m and κ = 2 if m ≤ n.

what_it_states: Let E/F be a CM extension and J a nondegenerate hermitian form of rank M. Then [U(J)] has finite volume. Moreover, for 2n < M and a nondegenerate hermitian n×n matrix T, the mean over [U(J)] of the theta series restricted to Gram matrix T equals the product of the local archimedean and p-adic Siegel densities at T. This is Siegel's formula for hermitian forms.
